title: TestPioneer workflow
description: A YAML workflow executed by test_pioneer.

pioneer_log.description: Log file path. When set, step execution is logged to this file.

recording_path.description: Screen recording output path, without extension. Needs test_pioneer[gui].

artifacts_path.description: Directory that receives <run-id>/ with the artifacts of a run. Defaults to artifacts.

keep_artifacts.description: What is kept when the run ends: only what failed (on_failure, the default), everything, or nothing.

steps.description: Steps, run in order. A failed step stops the ones after it.

runner.description: Runner that executes a JSON action file.

step.description: One step: a name plus exactly one action key and that action's fields.

name.description: Unique step name. close_program refers to an open_program step by it.

run.description: JSON action file to run, relative to the working directory.

run_folder.description: Folder whose *.json files are all run, in name order.

open_url.description: URL to open in the default browser.

download_file.description: URL of the file to download.

open_program.description: Program or command line to start. Close it by step name.

close_program.description: Name of the open_program step whose program is closed.

unzip_zipfile.description: Marks an unzip step. The archive is named by zip_file_path.

url_open_method.description: How the browser opens the URL. Defaults to open.

file_path.description: Local path the downloaded file is saved to.

redirect_stdout.description: File the program's standard output is written to.

redirect_stderr.description: File the program's standard error is written to.

zip_file_path.description: Path of the zip archive to extract.

extract_path.description: Directory to extract into. Defaults to the working directory.

parallel_run.description: Scripts started together as sub-processes, one runner per script.

runners.description: Runner of each script. Same length as scripts.

scripts.description: JSON action file of each runner. Same length as runners.

executor_path.description: Python executable that starts the runners. Defaults to this one.
